images.title: The front desk, *duty by duty*
rows: Answers on the first ring at any hour, several at once, from your own information.
Books, moves and confirms in your real calendar, following your rules for each type of visit.
Sends the day-before reminder and offers cancelled slots to the next person waiting.
Asks your intake questions, files work orders and sends the summary to the right person.
Collects the details and passes them to whoever owns billing. Makes no promises.
Gives your written emergency instructions and alerts the on-call person right away.

images.name: day-on-shift
images.title: A day at a *physio clinic*
rows: A patient books a 7:30 am assessment through web chat. It sends the intake form and the parking details.
Five calls come in at once about same-day slots. It answers all five and books the two open times.
A 2 pm patient cancels. It texts the waitlist and the slot is filled a few minutes later.
A patient asks why their insurer paid less than expected. It takes the details for the billing lead.
A caller describes a new injury and asks if it's serious. It books the earliest visit and flags it for a physio.
Sends tomorrow's reminders and moves two appointments when patients reply asking for a new time.
Answers an after-hours call about Saturday hours and books a first visit for next week.
